about.title: About us
about.lead: Vysiongids is Vysion’s hospitality guide: find businesses across Belgium, view info and order directly — with no commission via the guide.
about.whatWeDoBody: We map hospitality online: chip shops, restaurants, cafés and more. Owners manage their listing, photos, reviews and — if desired — premium features such as classifieds or a digital menu.
about.forVisitorsBody: Search by place, cuisine or amenities. Open business pages with address, hours and route. Order via the business link; Vysiongids is not between you and the business.
about.forHorecaBody: Add your business or log in to update details. Members can also discover Vysion’s order/reservation platform at preferential guide member rates.
about.vysionBody: Vysiongids is offered by Vysion, based at {street}, {cityLine}. Questions: {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: Vysiongids (Vysion hospitality guide) respects your privacy. This policy applies to vysiongids.be and related services.
section2Items: Data published by hospitality businesses and suppliers (name, address, opening hours, photos, links).
Reviews and ratings submitted by visitors.
Login for business owners: business name and a PIN you choose (stored securely, not readable).
Technical data: IP address, browser type, cookies for language and session.
Optional: location when you use «nearby» search (only with your consent in the browser).
section3Items: Showing the guide, search and managing business pages.
Managing your listing, menu, classifieds and premium features.
privacy.section4Body: We do not sell personal data. Hosting, database and email may use trusted processors. External links fall under those parties’ privacy policies once you click through.
privacy.section5Body: Listing and review data remain while your business is in the guide. After removal we delete listing and related data within a reasonable period, subject to legal retention.
privacy.section6Body1: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object and data portability where applicable.
privacy.section6Body2: Contact: {email}. You can also file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority (APD/GBA).
privacy.section7Body: We use functional cookies (language, logged-in manage session). Analytics cookies only if enabled and with consent where required.
privacy.section8Body: We may update this policy. The latest version is always shown in this popup.

zaakToevoegen.pageLead: Unique business name, 6-digit PIN and all * fields. After registration your business is online immediately.
zaakToevoegen.websiteHintHttps: https:// may be omitted — we add it automatically.
zaakToevoegen.orderUrlHint: Leave blank = the website link is used for «Order».
zaakToevoegen.photosHintRegister: At least 1 photo, up to 3. We automatically shrink large photos from your phone.
zaakToevoegen.introGatePromo1: Want to join Vysiongids? Tap {addBusinessBtn} at the top and follow every step. Your business card is free in the guide — customers can find you, view info and order directly. Classifieds and job ads are premium (€{horecaYearlyEur}/year). Your business is visible immediately to thousands of nearby customers and across Belgium.
zaakToevoegen.introGatePromo2: No reservation or online ordering software yet? As a Vysiongids member you can register via the buttons below. These modules are among the most professional platforms in Belgium. Download the software for €49/year — up to 20× cheaper than other platforms and only for Vysiongids members.
zaakToevoegen.introGatePromo3: Already have reservation and ordering software? Perfect — link it straight to your order button in Vysiongids. One click and the customer is on your system.
zaakToevoegen.introGateWhatIsP1: As a member you manage a free business card with details, photos, QR code and more. Thousands of customers search the guide. With premium (€{horecaYearlyEur}/year) you also post classifieds and jobs — visible immediately. Interested buyers can chat with you.
zaakToevoegen.introGateWhatIsP2: Your business links to your ordering platform, reservations, website, Facebook, etc. Need equipment or furniture? Under {navDiensten} all suppliers are listed — contact them or chat. Classifieds and jobs cost €{horecaYearlyEur}/year (hospitality premium). Selling under {navDiensten}? Register for €{dienstenYearlyEur}/year — visible to thousands of potential customers.
zaakToevoegen.introGateHowFindP1: Customers find you via searches like chip shop open now, nearby, or your name. More than 3,000 people use Vysiongids every day.
zaakToevoegen.introGateHowFindP2: Your card includes a QR code. Print it for your counter or packaging so customers order directly without commission platforms.
zaakToevoegen.introGateContinue: I have read this — continue registration
zaakToevoegen.introGateRulesLead: Before listing your business on Vysiongids, read the points below. This keeps the guide trustworthy for customers and all hospitality in Belgium.
zaakToevoegen.introGateConfirm: By continuing you confirm you have read this information and are authorised to register this business.

introGateRules.correctData: Accurate data: name, address, hours, phone, email and links must be correct. No misleading text or photos.
introGateRules.pin: Keep your PIN: the 6 digits are needed to log in, manage or delete your business later.
introGateRules.photos: Photos: upload only images of your business (at least 1, max. 3). No stock photos from other businesses.
introGateRules.orderLink: Order or reserve: the link goes straight to your site or shop — Vysiongids does not process orders and charges 0% commission.
introGateRules.reviews: Reviews: customers can post on your page. Do not respond with fake reviews.
introGateRules.delete: Removal: want to go offline? Log in and choose Delete your business in your account.
introGateRules.zoekertjes: Classifieds: do not post listings that break our rules — they will be removed immediately.
introGateRules.jobs: Job ads: do not post vacancies that break our rules — they will be removed immediately.
introGateRules.security: Security: never share bank details or other sensitive financial information with third parties.
